ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) patches concentrated at the distal tips; estimated macro-level white-to-black pixel ratio is approximately 0.25.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, irregular contiguous white blobs located at both the left and right distal tips; left tip features a dominant vertical white band; right tip contains fragmented white mottling; scattered white focal spots are present along the superior margin of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending significantly below the lobe apex line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary; serrations are most pronounced and jagged near the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex upward sweep originating from the median notch and extending to the acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular high-contrast white pixels (likely barnacle attachment sites) visible on the superior margin of the left lobe and embedded within the white patch of the right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions detected on the dark medial surface of the left lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography indicating cumulative physical trauma or wear; prominent white distal scarring on both lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetrical pigmentation pattern, specifically the broad, solid vertical white band on the far-left distal margin.
